Another great coffee from Julio's Finca El Zapote. This super clean coffee remains true to this farm's innovative, future-focused approach to coffee. Julio is one of our long-standing farming partners. We've yet to meet another agronomist as skilled as he is. He uses 20 years worth of carefully collected weather data to reference each crop against.

What is Pacamara? Why is it so special? The Pacamara variety is an intraspecific hybrid developed out of a breeding program housed at El Salvador's Institute for Coffee Research that started back in the 1950s. The two parents of its partial namesake, "PACA - MARA", are Pacas and Maragogype. Both are mutations. The Pacas variety, a natural mutation of the Bourbon variety, was discovered on the San Rafael farm in Santa Ana and is prized for its shorter size and increased productivity. Whereas Maragogype, a mutation of Typica, was sought after for its large bean size and excellent cup quality. After more than thirty years of artificially cross breeding selections and evaluating the progeny for desirable traits, the selected lines were combined to obtain the Pacamara variety, an exotic combination of productivity in the field and quality in the cup.

This coffee is a fully washed coffee that results in a clean, sweet and balanced profile with deep complexity. We taste mandarin orange, cocoa, and vanilla.

products.title: Electric Atmos Vacuum Canister
products.body_html:
An elegant and effortless way to extend the lifespan of your coffee beans and other treats. Coffee beans oxidize over time, losing the flavor and moisture that makes your cup taste great. Enter Electric Atmos, a unique storage canister that pumps out air with the touch of a button and creates a sealed vacuum inside. It also continually monitors the vacuum status and will automatically top it off if needed, and the rechargeable battery lasts for four months of continuous use so your goods can stay fresh even after a long vacation. Designed for coffee beans but open to all your other treats.

 

One touch vacuum seal

With just one push of the button, Electric Atmos creates a vacuum seal in seconds, banishing oxygen and preserving your goods.


Automatically maintains vacuum

Since coffee beans release carbon dioxide over time, Electric Atmos continually monitors the vacuum and will top it off when needed.


Intuitive LED indicators

Green means good! Thanks to clear LED indicators on the lid, you can always know the status of your seal.


Long battery life

The USB-C rechargeable battery lasts for over four months of daily use. Vacation planned? Electric Atmos will keep your goods fresh until you return.
